policy: Official legal/census documents were inspected from their canonical publisher URLs. Original PDF bytes are not redistributed in this packet because no explicit reuse license was located on the inspected documents. Restore from the exact URL and verify the recorded byte count and SHA-256 before reuse.

sources.title: Madagascar Law 2021-012
sources.license: No explicit license located; restore only for research and confirm terms before redistribution.
sources.inspection: Promulgated 2021-08-11. Annex assigns Mananjary, Nosy Varika and Ifanadiana to Vatovavy; Manakara, Ikongo and Vohipeno to Fitovinany. It states other commune/fokontany attachments remain unchanged. Article 7 makes effect contingent on radio/television publication or posting; the exact publication/effective date was not established here.

sources.title: Madagascar Law 2023-012
sources.license: No explicit license located; restore only for research and confirm terms before redistribution.
sources.inspection: Promulgated 2023-08-11. Creates Ambatosoa from Mananara Nord and Maroantsetra, states other district/commune attachments remain unchanged, and lists 24 regions and 1,695 communes. Article 7 makes effect contingent on radio/television publication or posting; exact publication/effective date was not established here.

sources.title: Madagascar Decree 2024-480
sources.license: No explicit license located; restore only for research and confirm terms before redistribution.
sources.inspection: Dated 2024-03-06. Article 1 schedules Antanimora Sud under Ambovombe prefecture with eight communes: Antanimora Sud, Ampamata, Andalatanosy, Imanombo, Jafaro, Marovato Befeno, Andragnanivo and Andoharano. Article 3 makes effect contingent on radio/television publication; exact publication/effective date was not established here.

sources.title: INSTAT RGPH-3 Definitif errata
sources.license: No explicit license located; restore only for research and confirm terms before redistribution.
sources.inspection: Inspected pp. 5–6: the page-81 column is explicitly Commune/Arrondissement and the corrected entry is Antanimora Atsimo. This is not district-level census evidence.

sources.title: OCHA/HDX Madagascar administrative population reference
sources.license: CC BY-IGO noted in inherited #482 source registry; upstream terms and attribution apply.
sources.retained_inputs: Inherited immutable files and hashes are pinned in each vintage input-pins.json. ADM2/ADM3/ADM4 CSVs contain 119/1,579/17,465 rows. The ADM3 row MG52516130 is Antanimora Atsimo, type Commune, parent ADM2 Ambovombe-Androy MG52516; 41 ADM4 rows carry its ADM3 code.

sources.title: OCHA COD-AB specification
sources.finding: valid_on records when the dataset version was last updated; it is not an administrative law effective date.

sources.title: INSTAT 21 April 2026 operational notice
sources.finding: Operational notice names Antanimora-Sud with four communes (Ampamata, Imanombo, Jafaro and Andoharano), fewer than Decree 2024-480's eight scheduled communes. Its operational purpose does not repeal the decree or define polygon boundaries; discrepancy unresolved.

sources.title: Madagascar government regions and districts portal
sources.finding: Page lists 23 regions/119 districts, separates Vatovavy and Fitovinany, places Mananara Nord and Maroantsetra under Analanjirofo and omits Antanimora. No visible update date; it conflicts with the later laws/decree and is treated as potentially stale, not controlling.

sources.title: MapAction Ambovombe-Androy 2022 mapbook
sources.role: Secondary lead only; mapbook states BNGRC, GADM and OSM inputs and depicts Antanimora Atsimo as commune MG52516130 under Ambovombe-Androy.
sources.limit: Does not establish legal continuity or polygon identity; exact original BNGRC predecessor bytes/metadata still need restoration.
